subject: Provisional MAP: Ephemeral Testcase Loan + Audit Trail Plan
summary: Agreement on short-term loan of evaluation testcases and prompt pack under a narrow usage pledge, timeline for delivery, audit logging requirements, and procurement next steps.
messages:
From: Kate Lang <kate.lang@brightretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Wu <alan.wu@brightretail.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: provisional MAP for ephemeral testcases + audit trail

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are ready to run a small evaluation against a representative slice of our customer queries, but procurement needs a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a clear usage pledge for the assets we’ll borrow (prompt packs + ~1k labeled testcases). A few must-haves for us:

- Ephemeral access only (30 days) with automated takedown.
- No training or redistribution.
- Audit logs showing who ran which prompts and token footprints.
- Minimal anonymization is acceptable for telemetry, but raw PII cannot leave our environment.

I attached a short MAP draft to speed things up (MAP_draft_v1.pdf). Can your team review and tell me if Redwood can meet the audit/logging requirements and propose a timeline for handover? Procurement wants a signed pledge before they issue the trial PO.

Kate
Kate Lang
Head of AI Product
BrightRetail
Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (6 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lang <kate.lang@brightretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provisional MAP for ephemeral testcases + audit trail

Kate —

Appreciate the clear ask and the draft MAP. We can support an ephemeral evaluation under the constraints you listed. Quick summary of what Redwood can commit to out of the box: 

- Ephemeral loan: we will provision a sandbox namespace with object-level TTL to expire the testcases after 30 days.
- Non-training commitment: data will be flagged as non-training; our infra will apply an internal marker so those tokens are excluded from any model-update pipelines.
- Audit trail: we will provide request-level logs (request id, timestamp, route/model used, token counts, anonymized requester id) and a downloadable CSV for your auditors. Full request payloads (with raw PII) can remain inside your VPC if you choose the Private eval connector; otherwise we will accept pre-scrubbed inputs.

Proposed near-term MAP items (I attached a short pledge you can sign):
- Day 0: MAP sign-off + PO issuance.
- Day 1–2: Provision sandbox, upload initial 1k testcases.
- Day 3–7: Run smoke tests and two curated prompt packs.
- Day 8–30: Full evaluation window.
- Day 31: Automated takedown + export of audit logs.

I've attached a one-page provisional-usage-pledge.docx that matches your constraints — if procurement is comfortable, we can accept a countersigned PDF and proceed. Monica will help coordinate the handoff and procurement details.

Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
m: (650) 555-0112
Attachments: provisional-usage-pledge.docx (8 KB)

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & procurement contacts for BR evaluation

Kate, Marcus —

Thanks for the details. A couple things from our side to keep the MAP lean and procurement-friendly: 

1) Timeline: we can meet the Day 0–31 cadence Marcus outlined, but procurement should allow a 3-business-day window for PO processing before Day 0.
2) Technical mode: if you want the tightest PII control, choose the Private eval connector; otherwise we'll accept a scrubbed dataset via our secure upload.
3) Procurement contact: can you loop in your procurement lead or authorize procurement@brightretail.com to sign the provisional pledge? We need a contact name + billing PO reference.

Action items:
- Kate: confirm procurement contact + whether BrightRetail will scrub PII or use Private connector.
- BrightRetail procurement: countersign provisional-usage-pledge.docx and return a signed PDF to marissa.contracts@redwood.ai (cc'd on final thread).

Naomi, will you own the audit-log export format?

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus & Monica —

We reviewed the pledge and procurement has signed off on the provisional-usage-pledge. I'm attaching our countersigned copy (BrightRetail_SIGNATURE.pdf).

Answers to your questions:
- Procurement contact: procurement@brightretail.com (PO ref: BR-PO-7789). They've authorized the sign-off on the provisional pledge for this evaluation.
- PII handling: we will scrub direct PII and send the dataset via your secure upload portal; we do not need the Private connector for this run.

Next steps as I see them:
1) You send secure upload instructions + pre-signed upload URL.
2) We upload the 1k testcases within 48 hours.
3) You confirm sandbox provisioning and provide ETA for audit log schema export.

Kate
